requirements.title: Android Platform Compatibility
requirements.definition: Modernize the Android application to use supported APIs and dependencies and remain compatible with current Android platform requirements.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers Android OS targeting, deprecated API replacement, and dependency modernization as one compatibility mechanism; permissions, bundle packaging, and package size have independent acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Android Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Reduce the Android application's user download size substantially while retaining required functionality and localization.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the Android size outcome and related optimization strategy; App Bundle delivery is a separately verifiable packaging behavior.

requirements.title: iOS Download Size Optimization
requirements.definition: Reduce the iOS application's user download size substantially while retaining required functionality and localization.
requirements.boundary_note: The iOS size outcome can differ from Android and has its own platform-specific trajectory; iOS thinning is separately testable packaging behavior.

requirements.title: App Skin Graphics Cleanup
requirements.definition: Clean up the application's skin graphics so the available visual themes are consistently presented.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns cleanup across the visual skins; measurement-control defects and iPad-specific layout behavior remain separate.

requirements.title: How-To-Use Content Delivery
requirements.definition: Provide functional How-To-Use guidance through the client-selected content and delivery mechanism on both mobile platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Tutorial images, translated overlays, and streamed video are successive delivery values of one help mechanism; app-size outcomes remain separate Requirements.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I went through both the Android and iOS source code carefully. Here's what I found and how I'd improve it.

**Current State**

Both apps work, but neither can be submitted to the stores today without some fixes.

**iOS Issues**

\* Uses UIWebView, which Apple removed — Apple will reject the app on submission.
\* Missing the Privacy Manifest file that Apple has required since May 2024.
\* Localization is broken — the app has 20 language folders, but the translation files inside are missing, so it actually runs in English no matter what language the phone is set to.
\* Signing certificates expired in 2015.
\* The Info.plist and main ViewController.m files are missing from the source you sent me — I'll need those to do iOS work.

**Android Issues**

\* The app is 89 MB — much larger than it needs to be. There's no Android App Bundle, no code shrinking, and no image optimization.
\* Requests the READ\_PHONE\_STATE permission (a sensitive permission) but doesn't actually use it. This can create issues during Google Play review in some regions.
\* Uses one removed sensor API and several other deprecated calls.
\* The Chinese video (Youku) doesn't work on modern Android because of an HTTP/HTTPS compatibility issue.
\* Uses very old library versions (7+ versions behind current releases).

**How I'd Improve It**

1\. Make it shippable again:
\* Replace UIWebView on iOS.
\* Add the required Privacy Manifest.
\* Refresh certificates.
\* Remove the unused dangerous permission on Android.

2\. Reduce app size significantly:
\* Switch Android to App Bundle format.
\* Enable code shrinking.
\* Remove duplicate and unused images.
\* I found approximately 10 MB of duplicate files on iOS alone.

3\. Fix localization properly:
\* Rebuild the broken iOS translation system.
\* Sync the Android language files (some languages are missing 26 strings).
\* Redesign tutorial images so new languages can be added without requiring graphic design updates every time.

4\. Update outdated code:
\* Upgrade dependencies.
\* Replace deprecated APIs.
\* Modernize the YouTube player implementation.

5\. Add RTL support if needed:
\* Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian are not supported correctly right now.

6\. Upgrade to current platform requirements:
\* Android 35 (required by Google soon).
\* iOS 15+.

**A Few Things I Need Before I Can Give Exact Timelines**

1\. The iOS source appears incomplete. I'm missing Info.plist and ViewController.m. Do you have the full project?
2\. Is the keystore password for the Android signing key available? It wasn't included in the files.
3\. Do you still need the Chinese (Youku) video, or can we remove it?
4\. For new languages, do you need full app localization or only translated store listing pages?

Let me know, and I can put together a detailed plan with estimated timeline.
